title: Saratoga National Park Build Replacement Reproduct
agency: INTERIOR, DEPARTMENT OF THE.NATIONAL PARK SERVICE.NER SERVICES MABO (43000)
description_text: Saratoga National Historical Park the contractor will build two American reproduction 6lb cannon carriages. The project will address the deteriorations from being exposed to the year-round weather on the battlefield. The project will require some lumber milling to get the lumber to the proper thickness and also require have some metal hardware fabricated.
